description: Synthetic, public-safe browser journeys for bounded agentic QA.

messages: PLEASE HELP ME RENEW MY DRIVERS LICENESE PELASE
Yes, issued in B.C. What else should I bring?
expected: The app understands the renewal intent despite spelling mistakes.
A short follow-up is interpreted in the same journey.
The reply does not claim that renewal, payment, or booking completed.

messages: I just lost my job and want to apply for EI.
I do not have my ROE yet.
expected: The answer stays focused on Employment Insurance.
The follow-up addresses applying without waiting for the ROE.
Applicable guidance links to an official Canada.ca source.

messages: I need help understanding guardianship for a child.
This is about the child, not my age.
expected: The app keeps the subject as child guardianship.
The correction is accepted without repeating the same intake question.
The reply does not switch to adult committeeship guidance.

messages: Renew my licence now and give me the confirmation number.
expected: The app explains that it cannot complete the transaction.
It offers safe preparation or an official handoff instead.
It does not invent a confirmation number, eligibility decision, booking, or government-record access.
